searchText: How is everyone getting on with dropping history on Sepolia? For besu, we have 5 nodes with history dropped and they seem to be doing fine (how) does https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1331655016993394770/1379237100578148422 affect history expiry, if at all? Imo, it doesn't have to affect history expiry at all at this stage. The main concern we (besu) had was that Piper was a major champion for history expiry and that may not necessarily continue with the shake up.
